hooks.command: bash -c 'p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$p" =~ out/.*-model\.md$ || "$p" =~ out/.*-(dcf|lbo|3-statement).*\.md$ ]]; then if ! grep -q "^## Sources" "$p"; then echo "[financial-analysis] model artefacts must include a ## Sources section before publication: $p" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$p" =~ out/.*-(ic-memo|deal-memo).*\.md$ ]]; then if ! grep -q "^CONFIDENTIAL" "$p"; then echo "[private-equity] IC/deal memos must carry a CONFIDENTIAL watermark at top of file: $p" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$p" =~ out/.*(pitch|deck|cim|teaser).*\.md$ ]]; then nums=$(awk '\''{ while (match($0, /[^[A-Za-z0-9_][0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/)) { c++; $0=substr($0, RSTART+RLENGTH) } } END { print c+0 }'\'' "$p"); cites=$(grep -oE "\[[0-9]+\]" "$p" | wc -l); if [[ "$nums" -gt 0 && "$cites" -lt $((nums/2)) ]]; then echo "[investment-banking] deck $p has $nums numeric values but only $cites footnote citations; institutional decks need [n]-style citations on at least half of figures" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$p" =~ out/.*-(research-note|coverage-init|target-price).*\.md$ ]]; then miss=""; grep -q "Target Price:" "$p" || miss="$miss Target Price:"; grep -q "Methodology:" "$p" || miss="$miss Methodology:"; if [[ -n "$miss" ]]; then echo "[equity-research] research note $p missing required provenance fields:$miss" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ -z "${CFA_TENANT_ID:-}" && -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" ]]; then export CFA_TENANT_ID="$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" 2>/dev/null)" || true; fi; p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; cfa security scan --for "$p" --action redact --hook-point pre-tool-use 2>&1 || true; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ -z "${CFA_TENANT_ID:-}" && -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" ]]; then export CFA_TENANT_ID="$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" 2>/dev/null)" || true; fi; p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; if [[ "$p" =~ out/.*\.(md|csv|json|tsv)$ && ! "$p" =~ \.audit\.json$ ]]; then cfa audit write --for "$p" >&2 || echo "[audit] manifest write failed for $p (non-blocking)" >&2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ -z "${CFA_TENANT_ID:-}" && -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" ]]; then export CFA_TENANT_ID="$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" 2>/dev/null)" || true; fi; p="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; [[ -z "$p" || ! -f "$p" ]] && exit 0; cfa security scan --for "$p" --action alert-only --hook-point post-tool-use 2>&1 || true; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ -z "${CFA_TENANT_ID:-}" && -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" ]]; then export CFA_TENANT_ID="$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" 2>/dev/null)" || true; fi; echo "${CLAUDE_MEMORY_TEXT:-}" | cfa security scan --stdin --action redact --hook-point pre-memory-write 2>&1 || true; exit 0'

bash -c 'if [[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" ]]; then tid="$(cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-.}/.cfa-tenant" 2>/dev/null)"; if [[ -n "$tid" ]]; then echo "[cfa] tenant context: $tid" >&2; fi; fi; exit 0'
